components.css: .ds-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:24px;padding:0 8px;border-radius:4px;background:#F5DAD2;color:#9A2E1E;border:1px solid rgba(178,58,39,.35);font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif}.ds-badge b{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-weight:500;font-size:13px}.ds-l{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-m{display:inline-flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:2px;height:12px}.ds-m i{width:3px;border-radius:1px;background:currentColor;opacity:.22}.ds-m i:nth-child(1){height:5px}.ds-m i:nth-child(2){height:7px}.ds-m i:nth-child(3){height:9px}.ds-m i:nth-child(4){height:12px}.ds-m i.on{opacity:1}

narrative.northStar: A case file, not a casino
narrative.overview: Ranked docket on the left, one open dossier on the right. Warm paper, ink-navy masthead, serif numerals, colour reserved for risk, one slate-blue accent. Evidence is a thread whose points sum to the score.

rules.name: Colour is never alone
rules.body: Risk always shows number + label + bars.

rules.name: Recommendation leads
rules.body: The only primary button is the recommended action.

dos: Do tie every score to reasons whose points sum to it
Do label demo data as synthetic
donts: Don't use casino or AI-dashboard styling
Don't use real OLG, Ontario or Canada branding
